standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic stacks through the quasi-compactness of the base changes along morphisms from quasi-compact algebraic stacks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on quasi-compact morphisms, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Formulates what has to be proved after the given base change is known to be quasi-compact.

standard_prerequisites.name: The existence of a smooth surjection from a scheme onto an algebraic stack, and the possibility of shrinking a flat surjective cover of a quasi-compact stack to a quasi-compact open
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 2165-2171)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a quasi-compact scheme cover of the test stack through which the quasi-compactness can be transported.

core_obligations: Set up the test: the proof takes a morphism from a quasi-compact algebraic stack and chooses a scheme smoothly surjecting onto the fibre product with the given cover (proof lines 2164-2167)

Shrink to quasi-compact: since the resulting map to the test stack is flat, surjective and locally of finite presentation, the proof finds a quasi-compact open subscheme of the scheme which still surjects onto the test stack (proof lines 2168-2171)

Transport quasi-compactness: the fibre product of that quasi-compact open with the source is a base change of the fibre product along the given cover, hence quasi-compact by assumption, and it surjects onto the base change of the test stack, which is therefore quasi-compact (proof lines 2172-2178)
proof_roadmap: 设给定基变换 W ×_Y X → W 准紧。取准紧代数叠 Z → Y 与概型 U 满光滑映到 W ×_Y Z。
由 U → Z 平坦、满、局部有限表现且 Z 准紧，取准紧开子概型 U' ⊂ U 使 U' → Z 仍满；于是 U' ×_Y X = U' ×_W (W ×_Y X) 由假设准紧，且满射到 Z ×_Y X，故后者准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is quasi-compact as soon as its base change along a surjective flat cover of finite presentation of the target by an algebraic space is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2153-2160, label lemma-check-quasi-compact-covering). The proof (source lines 2162-2179) takes an arbitrary morphism from a quasi-compact algebraic stack, chooses a smooth scheme cover of the relevant fibre product, shrinks it to a quasi-compact open which still surjects onto the test stack, and concludes that the base change along the test morphism is quasi-compact because it is a quotient of a quasi-compact base change (proof lines 2164-2178). The shrinking step is the content. H2.
